shortBio.en: Rush bassist/singer; Rickenbacker/Fender tone, high tenor, Moog foot-pedals live.
shortBio.zh: Rush 贝斯/主唱；Rickenbacker/Fender 音色、高男高音、现场 Moog 脚踏。

body.en:
Born 1953. Handles bass + lead vocal + synth layers. Tom Sawyer and YYZ show the dual-duty grammar.

Constant of the Peart-era trio with Lifeson.
body.zh:
1953 年生。兼贝斯+主唱+合成器层。Tom Sawyer 与 YYZ 展示双责语法。

与 Lifeson 组成 Peart 时期三人组的常量。
